parent_objective: design bounded earlier-window interventions after decision-step interventions produced null/weak effects
blocked_by: M1517 decision-step intervention starts after the policy has already reached a viable physical state
supersedes: candidate materialization from decision-step-only null intervention rows

public_gates: M1519 must design bounded timing-amplified interventions for the admitted T5 high-speed subset
M1519 must define reveal/reveal-plus-k/decision-minus-k intervention anchors and metrics
M1519 must preserve P0 actor contract and fixed public checkpoint
M1519 must not materialize candidates or export a training corpus
M1519 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during design
do not claim self-identification from timing-amplification design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs earlier-window interventions to test whether M1517 was null because decision-step injection was too late
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: intervention timing design only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if timing-amplified interventions require actor-input contract changes
stop if design needs untracked simulator state mutation
stop if design would materialize candidates before measured earlier-window effects
stop if design cannot define a hard synthesis trigger after one implementation and audit
fallback_plan: if earlier-window interventions cannot be implemented safely, route to terminal-boundary retarget design
if implementation would be too broad, choose reveal and decision-minus-8 anchors only
if timing-amplified smoke is still null, route to branch synthesis or terminal-boundary retarget repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1518 audited M1517 as null/weak and recommended timing amplification before retarget repair

admission_evidence: M1518 found decision-step reset hidden changed actions but did not create outcome-relevant gaps, suggesting the injection point may be too late or rows too stable
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up bounded timing-amplified implementation or branch synthesis manifest
next_stage_criteria: same-current and diverging-trajectory interpretations are separated
mandatory audit or synthesis trigger is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1519 only designs earlier-window interventions. Any later null result may still mean current-frame response or scene geometry is sufficient, so self-ID claims remain blocked.
history_necessity_tests: design reveal-to-terminal and decision-minus-k interventions that let history perturbations affect the physical setup before the emergency decision
separate same-current diagnostic variants from diverging-trajectory timing-amplified variants
pre-register that null effects lead to branch synthesis or terminal-boundary retargeting
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1517/M1518 admitted T5 high-speed rows, with interventions moved earlier than the decision step.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If timing amplification does not produce outcome-relevant gaps, record the null result and synthesize or retarget instead of weakening the self-ID claim standard.
allowed_claims: M1519 designs bounded timing-amplified T5 interventions
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Earlier-window interventions can test whether M1517 was null because decision-step injection was too late, while preserving no-training and no-materialization guardrails.
success_criteria: design defines reveal, reveal-plus-k, and decision-minus-k intervention anchors or explicitly narrows them
design separates same-current diagnostics from diverging-trajectory timing-amplified rollouts
design keeps candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export blocked
design routes to one bounded implementation or mandatory synthesis
failure_criteria: intervention timing or interpretation is ambiguous
design changes actor inputs or uses private holdout
design materializes candidates or starts training PPO promotion corpus export
decision_rule: M1519 passes if it designs bounded earlier-window T5 interventions and preserves all no-training no-materialization guardrails.
